paper_title: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer
notes: DAMNED unequal-delay interferometer experiment constrains oscillating scalar DM couplings d_e (ScalarPhoton) and d_me (ScalarElectron) in mass range [4.1e-11, 8.3e-10] eV. The paper presents limits on BOTH d_e and d_me independently (maximum reach approach), so coupling type is ambiguous between ScalarPhoton and ScalarElectron; confidence lowered accordingly. Numerical exclusion data only available in Fig.3 plots (frequency 10-200 kHz), no data tables with coupling values provided.
